title: To-dos
description: The person's to-do list: add items, tick them off, delete them and clear the done ones. Open items show first, done ones after, struck through. Documents in "todos": { text: string, done: boolean }. Add one with put("todos", { text, done: false }); tick one with patch("todos", id, { done: true }).
